title: Data Quality Validator for Request Logs
signature: def validate(records, expectations, refs=None, id_column="request_id", sample_size=3)
hints: A null is a missing key or None. Only not_null looks at nulls; every other check skips them and does not count them as evaluated.
In Python, True is an int. Check for bool before int.
regex means the whole value: re.fullmatch, not re.match.
For unique, count every value first, then fail every row whose value occurs more than once, including the first one.
